content:
Riley Zhou: Hi folks, onboarding snag. Okta login works but Git HTTPS access still asks for username/password. SSH key upload in the console says 'key already exists' but my SSH agent isn't listing any keys. Also 1Password CLI invite landed at riley.z.personal@gmail.com. Any quick fix?
Tom (People Ops): Welcome Riley! :wave: DM'd you to confirm personal email. We'll remove it and resend 1Password invite to your corporate email.
Riley Zhou: DM sent. Thanks.
IT Support: Creating ticket ONB-8210. Quick checks: 1) Did you accept the GitHub org invite? 2) For SSH, are you looking at `ssh-add -l` output? 3) Is the repo using HTTPS fallback or SSO-protected SAML?
Riley Zhou: I accepted the GitHub invite. `ssh-add -l` returns "The agent has no identities." I cloned via HTTPS because `git@github.com:` fails.
Maria (IT): Sounds like keys exist in the user profile (GitHub/Okta) but not on your machine. If the console says "key already exists" it's likely you previously uploaded a public key under a different account or alias. Try `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "riley@redwood.com"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste to your GitHub profile. If upload errors persist, tell us the exact error.
DevEx - Priya: For corporate Git + SSO we prefer SSH keys tied to Okta-backed GitHub account. If you need a temporary token, you can use `gh auth login` with SSO (follow prompts) or generate a PAT via the web (less ideal). I can force SCIM/SCIM group reprovision if GitHub org mapping didn't pick up your alias.
provisioner-bot: [ONB-8210] SCIM resync requested by DevEx - Priya for user riley.zhou at 1951234620.
1password-bot: Invite resent to riley@redwood.com by Tom (People Ops).
Riley Zhou: Okay re-uploaded key after regenerating and added it to GitHub web UI. `ssh -T git@github.com` now says "Hi riley! You've successfully authenticated." 1Password invite arrived in work email too.
IT Support: Running final checks: closing ONB-8210 in 24h if no follow-ups. If you see any repo-level permission errors ping us with the repo name.
Riley Zhou: All good at 1951234700. Thanks everyone! :tada:
